---
title: "debug_getRawReceipts"
---

Returns an array of EIP-2718 binary-encoded receipts.

This method will use `80` [Compute Units](/nodeapi/about/billing).

***

## **Parameters**

`blockNumber` - Quantity (hex) | Tag - <span style={{color: "red"}}>Required</span>  - The block number as a string in hexadecimal format or latest

## **Returns**

`result` - An array of EIP-2718 binary-encoded receipts.

```json wrap
// Result
{
	"jsonrpc": "2.0",
	"result": [
		"",
		...
}
```

<CodeGroup>

```bash title="mainnet"
curl https://mainnet.monad.validationcloud.io/v1/<YOUR_API_KEY_HERE> \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0", "method":"debug_getRawReceipts","params":["latest"],"id":1}'
    
```

```bash title="testnet"
curl https://testnet.monad.validationcloud.io/v1/<YOUR_API_KEY_HERE> \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0", "method":"debug_getRawReceipts","params":["latest"],"id":1}'
    
```

</CodeGroup>
